items.title: Applied Materials (AMAT) Ties Its $5 Billion EPIC Center To Next Gen AI Memory
items.summary: Applied Materials (NasdaqGS:AMAT) has entered a major R&D partnership with KIOXIA focused on next generation memory for AI workloads. The collaboration will be based at Applied Materials' new US$5b EPIC Center, targeting memory cell structures, multi chip stacking and advanced packaging. Both companies plan to work on improving manufacturability and density of future memory technologies tailored for AI focused chip architectures.
